speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: God, if anyone can build an app in a weekend now, what's actually becoming valuable?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Not the app. The people waiting for it.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Wait, the app isn't the valuable part?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Over half a million new apps hit the App Store in just six months this year. That's almost as many as all of last year, but downloads only went up 2%.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: So everybody's building and nobody's downloading?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Picture two taco trucks. Same tacos. One has a line of people down the street. Anyone can make tacos now. The line is the valuable part.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Okay, but how do I get a line? I have like nine followers.

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: You don't need millions. You need a few hundred people with the same problem. Step one, pick one kind of person and one problem you know well, like parents with picky eaters.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: How do I find out what they need?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Step two, in the Claude app, ask me to find what parents of picky eaters complain about most online. I search and hand you their top 10 problems in their own words.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Then I build the app.

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: That's the mistake everybody makes. They build for months, then launch to nobody. Step three, post one free tip for them every day. I can turn each problem into a short video script.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Why give it away for free?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Free help is how strangers start to trust you. Trust is what builds the line at your taco truck. Step four, get them on an email list. Kit is free for your first 10,000 people.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Why email? I already have followers.

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Followers are rented. Instagram can change its rules any day. Your email list is yours. Kit gives you a free sign up page. Put its link in your Instagram bio.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Okay, now do I build the app?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Almost. Here's the tip most people skip. Sell it before you build it.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Sell an app that doesn't even exist yet?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Ask me for one screen of it. Email a screenshot to your list. Sell early access in Kit for $5. They pay now and get it first. If 10 people pay, we build the rest this weekend. If nobody pays, you just saved a month.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: So the app is the easy part now?

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: Anyone can make the tacos. Not everyone has the line.

speaker: SPEAKER 1
text: Okay, one free tip every day. I'm starting next Monday.

speaker: SPEAKER 2
text: You said that last Monday. Ask me anything.
